1. take note (i)
we were between two worlds, hot tensions blurred -- your reflection waiting on the other side,
this game of hide and seek, with a smile so bleak, your suffering so innocent, too sweet; as i wait
for you here to find me.
bending space, erasing waves and patterns and figurines in my head. instead of the lure, its the
chase til we come face to face with our golden boy. perfection, outraced his dimension to meet
me in mine. shows me his palm, shows me a sign. synchronized moments treading still like
untouched water, untampered thrill, fear of self and what's real. we are the same, but you don't
speak like i do, you make this a game. a game to me as we relinquish what? spirit? soul? an
exchange? my hearts felt better days, but i already knew that everything takes time to get used to.
you are living in thoughts of Disney, mind in wonderland, hoping for an elysian eternity. the
stains on the bubble you call home is ruble open for all to see. you roam through make-believe
determined for fantasy. you know i live there too. you know i paint the sky blue. you know you
feel it too. you know i know what's true. you know i believe you too. praise the golden rule that
this life has taught you, the time its bought you, the lessons not yet caught up to you. yes -- you
are Disney, but even there you'll never be free. open up to this world and i can promise you'll get
to where you need to be. you are living in the wrong life.
look at me: i am made of magic, its real the static is rising. i’m finding the fire more & more as
time becomes me. death in stardust, heavy blush on kitschy memories and hickeys formed out of
mourning. distasteful blessings but beauty all the same. i blame the magic, i blame the static. i
blame the unholy halo on unholy earth, mind set to rebirth in ash and flame. shame the turmoil,
shame the outskirts of your memories that linger in my shadow -- as if I'm caught in a
thunderstorm. reborn. reborn. the journey mumbling under your stumbling tongue too fast to hear
a sound but too slow for me, raging flow through distorted fate or distorted destiny. you decide.
my mind is flawed as yours is flawed. our scorning ghosts twist us through silence, through thin
air, through the stares you make and break me in two, through ash, through storm, through birth,
through my unholy halo on unholy earth.
2. take note (ii)
utopia is as thin as glass, ready to break on memories racing by too fast. utopia is not a dream, its
a clean state of mind. utopia isn't perfection or the most beautiful, utopia is satisfaction,
contentment, peace. at least stay on this heaven before we find utopia on the next. as utopia is not
a place, it lives in every desire in special taste, in every connection we make and in each breath
we take when we stop focusing so much on our own hearts and start focusing on ones that don't
belong to us.
because in these moments i find myself ticking too fast, blasted out of sync, thinking myself into
the ground. when i was younger i thought i knew what was needed to be found but i was wrong.
exploring poems, new songs, blue love, true love, anything and everything. its only myself to
find what i’m looking for, no magic man or door is there for curing me. if freedom is a choice
then i guess i haven’t always made the right one. so IT IS now, it must be, and not whats been
done. now, now, now. there is a part of me and you that knows how to do this. never a simple fix
or kiss but a flick on the lips to say: "i WILL be better. for ALWAYS, til forever." my three rules:
watch out for signs and trust them, do not question what you find and have more compassion in
the world (and for YOU) for all things take time. the last one is hard cos i like to live on the
defense but patience exists for a reason. put yourself first if you need to, be unapologetic through
it too, cos one day all of it will really make sense. listen to YOUR voice, listen out for freedom
as it becomes the right choice. one day, right?
let's see. focus. cos at least for me, ill fight for that, ill rise up, rise for freedom. i will rise. i will
be free. for i have FAITH in this eternity --

15. silence
Silence.
Your mouth lays
dormant. Mine is aching.
Silence.
Your drawn-out heartbeats are barely
noticeable under mutual
heavy breathing.
Silence.
Your eyes flutter
like child’s first sunlight, but
you were born too late to feel this way
and I know your mind is otherwise sealed shut.
Silence
Your vision is of me watching you.
it’s rare I can no longer see the street marks of
your skin as it trails the pathway to your uneasy mind
as you rock backwards and forwards through rendering of
words I cannot fathom to speak; moments like this tell me "in time."
Silence.
Your silence is a curse, that pushes me into you.
Your silence is a vile demon, that pushes me into you.
Your silence is a pain and stake to the heart, that forces me into you.
Your silence cannot be real, since if you would speak you’d mutter something
stupid, something benign, something meaningful.
But our silence is limited by experience, limited by my paranoia.
and your silence is us falling in love.
Silence.
I cannot bare another moment without your silence,
presence illuminates everything,
raw presence,
raw silence,
reality.
Your silence is real.
